findings.defect: The source refers to Butter Rings, a Korean cookie brand whose name forms a joke with the preceding complaint about buffering; changing it to generic butter loses both the object and most of the wordplay.
findings.rationale: Retaining the product name preserves the buffering/Butter Rings joke without adding explanation to the chat.
findings.replacement: Now I want some Butter Rings.

findings.current: “Ah, we killed the raid monster, so you don’t have to worry too much.”
findings.defect: The translation inserts an explicit plural subject and attributes the kill to a group, while the Korean leaves the subject unstated. It also makes the action more explicitly lethal than 잡았으니까 requires here.
findings.rationale: A passive construction preserves the source’s omitted subject and the deadpan reassurance without prematurely assigning credit.
findings.replacement: “Ah, the raid monster has already been taken down, so you don’t have to worry too much.”
findings.source: “아, 레이드 몬스터는 잡았으니까 너무 걱정하지 않으셔도 됩니다.”

findings.defect: The current line changes “It’s just as I said” into a claim about deliberately chosen meaning, giving Taekyung a more forceful and self-conscious tone than the source.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves Taekyung’s matter-of-fact response to the request for repetition.

findings.current: “This is probably the best way to put it. I ‘took care of him.’”
findings.defect: Although the euphemistic meaning is present, “took care of him” does not carry the waste-processing sense of 처리 that sets up the immediate recycling joke.
findings.rationale: “Disposed of” remains a euphemism for killing while preserving the lexical connection to treating Won Myunghoon like refuse.
findings.replacement: “This is probably the best way to put it. I ‘disposed of him.’”

findings.current: The investigators clicked their tongues after confirming that the enormous Named Monster was dead in a grisly fashion.
findings.defect: 혀를 내두르다 expresses astonishment or marveling here, not the disapproval conveyed by “clicked their tongues.” The investigators’ reaction to Taekyung’s feat is reversed.
findings.rationale: The surrounding exclamations show that they are amazed he defeated it alone, and the replacement preserves that reaction.
findings.replacement: The investigators were stunned when they confirmed that the enormous Named Monster lay gruesomely dead.
findings.source: 거대한 네임드 몬스터가 처참하게 죽어 있는 것을 확인한 조사단은 혀를 내둘렀고,

findings.current: Kim Jonghun, the Star Guild’s Team One Leader, confessed to everything that had happened while his already-fragile mental state had yet to fully recover.
findings.defect: “Already-fragile” invents a preexisting psychological weakness; the Korean says his mind had become weakened and had not yet recovered. “Team One Leader” also departs from the established title “Team 1 Leader.”
findings.rationale: This preserves his condition as the consequence of recent events rather than an established trait and uses the binding title.
findings.replacement: Kim Jonghun, the Star Guild’s Team 1 Leader, confessed to everything that had happened before he had fully recovered from his shaken state.
findings.source: 스타 길드의 1팀장, 김종훈은 심약해진 정신을 온전히 추스르지 못한 상태에서 지금까지의 일들을 모두 고백했다.

findings.current: “They filmed the whole raid. There’s footage on the USB. Open it and you’ll see. That bastard Won Myunghoon was a real piece of work.”
findings.defect: “A real piece of work” substantially softens 죽일 놈, which is a strongly abusive condemnation of Won Myunghoon.
findings.rationale: The stronger profanity matches the source’s anger and avoids sanitizing the investigator’s judgment.
findings.replacement: “They filmed the whole raid. There’s footage on the USB. Open it and you’ll see. That bastard Won Myunghoon was a real piece of shit.”
findings.source: “레이드 과정을 다 찍었답니다. USB 열어 보시면 영상 있습니다. 원명훈 그 자식, 죽일 놈이더라고요.”

findings.defect: The literal nouns are unnatural English and obscure the comment’s meaning: Won deserved his fate, and killing him was justified.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally conveys both halves of the blunt online reaction while preserving its approval of the killing.
findings.replacement: Good riddance. Killing him was the right call.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it assigns an ambiguous action to a group, weakens several jokes and profanities, reverses the investigators’ reaction, and adds a preexisting character trait not present in the source.
